fields.description: Shoreline by DAMAC is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Its original collection includes one- to three-bedroom apartments and four- and five-bedroom townhouses. The design brings Vincent Faudemer's Babolex collaboration into a building with shared pools, gardens and leisure spaces.

overview: The brochure separates ground-level facilities from rooftop recreation. The floor-plan pack includes conventional apartments and larger two-level townhouses. Its sample two-bedroom drawing includes a maid room, illustrating why ancillary rooms and exact layouts should be checked for the chosen type rather than inferred from a bedroom count.
research.locationNote: The project is on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, with beachfront access described in its own brochure. Confirm the selected residence's orientation, route to the beach and amenity access; a waterfront address does not guarantee the same view from every home.
research.priceNote: Tanami reports an original guide from AED 1.83m. A later KMJ offer instead starts at AED 4.534m for its selected two-bedroom homes. These references concern different dates and available selections; the historic headline does not imply an available one-bedroom home today.
research.paymentNote: Tanami reports an original 70/ 30 structure: 20% at booking, 50% during construction and 30% on handover. KMJ's later selected-unit offer uses 20/ 30/ 50. The table shows the original reported structure only; the exact current unit schedule needs written confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Tanami reports July 2028 and KMJ reports Q3 2028. The displayed quarter covers those references, but the selected residence's contractual completion terms still require confirmation.
